verdict.rationale: Algolia ships a first-party REST API and official API clients across many languages, plus a dedicated CLI explicitly documented as 'great for interactive commands, scripts, and continuous integration workflows,' enabling fully headless/automated/CI use. Authentication via headers (x-algolia-application-id/x-algolia-api-key) supports non-interactive automation, and data ingestion pipelines (Crawler, integrations) can be scheduled/configured without deploying code, reinforcing automatable operation. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on CI pipeline example or explicit non-interactive CLI auth flow (docs show browser-based login) that would confirm frictionless headless CLI use in automated environments.
